notes:
v2.4.0 adds Google Calendar sync, job visits and a claim builder.

Google Calendar: connect a calendar in Settings and your Schedule syncs both ways, with jobs and visits on the same calendar.

Jobs: plan visits from the job's tasks, print a worksheet for the day, and record what got done. + New Claim builds a progress claim from that work, including part-done tasks, visit hours and materials, and nothing can be claimed twice.

Schedule: month view, drag-and-drop rescheduling, standalone events, and Convert to Job.

Point of Sale (Tyro): split card-and-cash payments and refunds, surcharge refunds, and receipts for refunds, declines and cancellations.

Also: voiding an invoice frees what it billed, a fix for job numbers clashing, updated guides, and EULA 6.1 (payroll is not part of the Pro Trial).
